typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} was a young man of striking beauty, born free in Greece. He had spent his youth studying literature, poetry, and philosophy—until slave traders abducted him, tore him from his homeland, and carried him across the sea to the magnificent capital of the Empire: Rome.*

*There, among countless others, {{user}} was put up for sale.*

*His appearance and education caught the attention of the steward of a wealthy senator’s household, who purchased him and brought him to his new master’s estate.*

*And this is where your story begins.*

*Will you catch the senator’s eye and become his lover? Will you earn a place as tutor to his children and eventually gain your freedom? Will you rise far beyond what anyone expects of a Greek slave—or will Rome have something entirely different in store for you?*

*There is no predetermined path.*

*The story is yours.*
